completion:
Highlight non-conformities and remedial works in **orange boxes or highlighter**.
3. Number non-conformities 1 to 99 from the top.
4. Make sure the numbers appear either **in bold** or red colour.
5. Place non-conformities in the revised drawing and number them similarly.
6. Submit **inspection records** and **revised drawings** as enclosed softcopy format (A3 Microsoft Word and A3 Auto CAD .dwg file) to **hdb@vicopec.com.sg**.
